experiment.pilot_note: Acceleration is cast before the fixed registered core-named-spell sequence each turn; this deliberately gives no priority to post-burn ritual casts and still excludes other cascade-eligible hand-spells. Mode off must be byte-for-byte compatible with prior paid-engine observations on a per-seed per-variant basis.

Lotus Petal.effect: Artifact cast from hand for 0, enter, tap and sacrifice to create red under fixed color policy. Move card to graveyard, once only.

Sol Ring.effect: Artifact cast from hand for generic 1, tap immediately to add 2 colorless and remain tapped until next own turn (predecessor's turn-start auto-tap behavior).

Mana Vault.effect: Artifact cast from hand for generic 1, tap once immediately for 3 colorless; stays tapped across untaps and is not reused without paying {4} on an upkeep (upkeep untap omitted). If tapped at any later modeled draw step, deals 1 damage to pilot per turn.

Dark Ritual.effect: Instant cast from hand in main for B; adds BBB then card enters graveyard. Birgi front, if present, adds one red cast trigger before resolution.

Cabal Ritual.effect: Instant cast from hand for 1B, adds BBB, or BBBBB if threshold of at least seven cards in pilot graveyard is true when it resolves. Pilot only graveyard; no guessed threshold.

Rite of Flame.effect: Sorcery cast from hand in main for R, adds RR plus R per OTHER Rite already in any tracked graveyard (singleton baseline, other opponents' yards not tracked). Effect resolves before own card goes into graveyard.

conditional_mechanics: All cast spells draw from a physically held hand; no accelerant is present unless in the correct physical zone and source-cost payable.
Each cast pays actual Grixis mana pips and generic through same tapped lands/pool; Birgi adds one additional red only if already present at time of cast.

Nightscape Familiar discounts blue and red SPELLS generic only. Of the registered hand accelerants only red Rite has any red, but printed {R} contains no generic; no discount for black rituals or colorless artifacts.
Do not count the cost source of Lotus Petal until after it has been legally cast; pay 0, use red on resolution. Do not give Sol Ring color choices; produces two C only.
Mana Vault is not Sol Ring: no automatic untap step, its own once-paid untap at upkeep excluded; later draw-step 1 damage applies if tapped.
Cabal Ritual threshold is evaluated at resolution; this main-phase graveyard includes previously cast ritual/burn/fetch/cascade spells, not cast spell itself.

Physical conservation includes 99 named cards across remaining library, hand, lands, noncommander permanents, and own graveyard at end of each turn. Single commander remains command zone or battlefield.
All non-Ignus Abaddon hand-cast cascade triggers remain omitted: extension intentionally changes mana access only and does NOT claim more full effect coverage.
No extra physical draw/tutor from hand, no chrome mox/LED mana, no taps from other rocks, no combat, no death, no stax/opponent actions, no commander tax. Zero wins or superiority inference.
The same frozen 100-card list and same PR524 supported cascade effect runner is used for both modes, so changed counts measure a specific model-extension policy rather than true gameplay win rates.
pre_ci_clarification: Removed per-checkpoint commander presence reporting because the existing PR524 baseline only exposes commander presence in the final end-state; reuse that as earlier checkpoint access would backdate casts. All paired Ignus and paid-cascade checkpoint counts remain directly predecessor-compatible.
